subject: sub-13
notes: Manual ICA decisions after reviewing topographies and properties.

0.label: edge_artifact
0.notes: Extremely focal red hotspot confined entirely to the right temporal/mastoid edge with no visible counter-pole on the scalp. Activity is at the boundary; not a dipolar field. Very low power spectrum and extreme variance spikes confirm artifact.

1.label: global_noise_component
1.notes: Nearly uniform warm/red field across the entire scalp with a small central blue region; classic non-dipolar global pattern. No clear neural dipole axis. Reject.

2.label: eye_blink_artifact
2.notes: Strong frontal positivity dominating the anterior scalp with a sharp inferior boundary and blue at the very bottom edge; topography is consistent with eye/EOG artifact. Extreme variance spikes and high low-frequency power confirm this. Reject.

3.label: global_noise_component
3.notes: Globally blue field with a small warm central region; the field is diffuse, non-dipolar, and spatially unstructured. Extremely large variance outlier (15000 AU). Reject.

4.label: global_noise_component
4.notes: Broad blue field covering most of the scalp with a focal region at the posterior-inferior boundary; no clean dipolar axis. The field wraps around the scalp edge. Reject.

5.label: mixed_component
5.notes: Focal red hotspot at the left posterior-parietal region with a diffuse blue surround at the top; the two poles are not positioned along a plausible dipolar axis and the red region is somewhat focal. Not a clean dipole. Reject.

6.label: mixed_component
6.notes: Broad warm/red field with a focal inferior red hotspot and a small blue region at the fronto-central area; multi-polar and non-dipolar. Spectrum shows a slight low-frequency peak but topography is not consistent with a clean neural source. Reject.

7.label: global_noise_component
7.notes: Central blue region surrounded by a broad warm/red ring covering the entire scalp periphery; this is a radial/global pattern, not a dipolar field. Consistent with a reference or global noise artifact. Reject.

8.label: edge_artifact
8.notes: Very focal blue hotspot confined to the right temporal/mastoid edge with essentially no meaningful field elsewhere on the scalp. Clearly at the boundary; not a neural dipole. Very low power spectrum. Reject.

9.label: mixed_component
9.notes: Left-right asymmetric pattern with warm red at the left and blue at the right fronto-parietal area; the boundary between poles is irregular and the field is not spatially smooth. More consistent with a movement or mixed artifact than a dipole. Extreme variance spikes. Reject.

10.label: edge_artifact
10.notes: Focal blue hotspot at the right temporal/mastoid edge with a small pink counter-region below the rim; activity is concentrated at the scalp boundary. Not a spatially smooth dipole. Reject.

11.label: global_noise_component
11.notes: Globally uniform blue field with a single very focal blue hotspot at the inferior-posterior boundary; non-dipolar and spatially unstructured. Large variance outliers. Reject.

12.label: eye_blink_artifact
12.notes: Strong frontal positivity covering the anterior-superior scalp with a blue region at the posterior/inferior boundary; classic fronto-posterior dipole pattern consistent with eye blink/EOG. High variance and 1/f spectrum confirm this. Reject.

13.label: mixed_component
13.notes: Focal blue region at the left temporal edge embedded in a broadly warm field, with the main red activity irregularly distributed; fragmented and non-dipolar. Not a clean neural source. Reject.

14.label: mixed_component
14.notes: Focal red hotspot at the right posterior-parietal area with a central blue region and broad warm surround; the spatial arrangement is irregular and asymmetric relative to a plausible dipole axis. Extreme variance outlier (16000 AU). Reject.

15.label: edge_artifact
15.notes: Very tight focal red hotspot at the left fronto-temporal rim with a small adjacent blue counter-region; activity is concentrated at the scalp boundary. Spectrum shows unusual flat/elevated broadband power consistent with muscle or edge artifact. Reject.

16.label: mixed_component
16.notes: Focal red hotspot at the left temporal area with a broad blue surround; the red region is compact and near the scalp edge, lacking a proper dipolar counter-pole at an appropriate distance. Not a clean neural dipole. Reject.

17.label: mixed_component
17.notes: Focal red hotspot at the right fronto-central area with a broad blue surround; though there is a visible polarity contrast, the red region is asymmetric and positioned near the scalp edge rather than forming a clean central dipole. Extreme variance spikes. Reject.

18.label: global_noise_component
18.notes: Broadly blue field covering the entire upper scalp with a warm lower boundary; non-dipolar and spatially unstructured. Extremely large variance outliers (up to 20000 AU) confirm this is a noise component. Reject.

19.label: edge_artifact
19.notes: Very focal red hotspot at the left fronto-temporal edge/rim with concentric contour lines crowded near the scalp boundary and a small adjacent blue counter-region; activity is concentrated at the boundary. Segment image shows persistent broadband noise. Reject.

20.label: global_noise_component
20.notes: Warm/red field covering most of the scalp with a focal blue region at the right posterior area; the blue is asymmetric and embedded in a broadly warm surround without forming a clean dipolar axis. Extreme variance outlier (33000 AU). Reject.

21.label: edge_artifact
21.notes: Focal red hotspot at the right posterior-temporal edge with a small adjacent blue counter-region, both near the scalp boundary; not a spatially smooth dipole. Flat broadband spectrum with no neural peaks. Reject.

22.label: edge_artifact
22.notes: Focal blue hotspot concentrated at the left temporal/mastoid edge with essentially no field elsewhere on the scalp. Activity is confined to the scalp boundary. Extreme variance outliers (up to 6500 AU). Reject.

23.label: global_noise_component
23.notes: Broadly warm/red field covering the entire scalp periphery with a large central blue region; this is a radial/global non-dipolar pattern. Consistent with a reference or common mode artifact. Reject.

24.label: global_noise_component

26.label: mixed_component

27.label: mixed_component

28.label: edge_artifact

30.label: edge_artifact
30.notes: Very tight focal red hotspot at the left fronto-temporal edge with concentric contours crowded at the scalp boundary; no meaningful counter-pole visible. Flat broadband spectrum and high variance across segments confirm edge artifact. Reject.

31.label: edge_artifact
31.notes: Focal red hotspot at the left fronto-temporal area near the scalp rim with a broad diffuse blue surround; the red activity is asymmetric and near the boundary. Extreme variance outlier (3500 AU). Reject.

32.label: mixed_component
32.notes: Focal blue hotspot at the right parietal-temporal area with a broad warm surround and a small red region at the inferior-left; the poles are spatially irregular and do not form a coherent dipolar axis. Extreme variance outlier (22000 AU). Reject.

33.label: eye_artifact
33.notes: Frontal-dominant topography with smooth anterior spread and slow ERP drift; lacks clear dipolar structure. Consistent with ocular/blink-related activity. Reject.

34.label: movement_artifact
34.notes: Widespread high-amplitude activation with no coherent spatial pattern and extreme variance outlier (~60000 AU). Likely movement or electrode artifact. Reject.

35.label: brain_component
35.notes: Focal central-frontal activation with relatively smooth topography and stable spectrum; no extreme variance spikes. Likely neural signal. Keep.

36.label: muscle_artifact
36.notes: Localized activity near temporal/edge regions with noisy ERP and non-dipolar shape. Typical of muscle activity. Reject.

37.label: muscle_or_eye_artifact
37.notes: Strong lateralized hotspot on left hemisphere without symmetric counterpart; irregular field pattern suggests non-neural origin (muscle or lateral eye artifact). Reject.

38.label: noise_artifact
38.notes: Posterior-dominant but diffuse pattern with unstable ERP and large variance outlier (~25000 AU). Likely noise or movement contamination. Reject.

39.label: mixed_artifact
39.notes: Apparent dipole but overly strong and unstable with multiple variance spikes; lacks clean neural consistency. Borderline but safer to reject.

40.label: noise_component
40.notes: Weak amplitude with edge-dominated spatial pattern and flat ERP; no meaningful spectral features. Likely noise. Reject.

41.label: slow_artifact
41.notes: Diffuse large-scale pattern with low-frequency dominance and no clear dipole; resembles global drift or slow artifact. Reject.

42.label: movement_artifact
42.notes: Strong widespread activation with irregular contours and large variance spikes; inconsistent with neural sources. Likely movement/electrode artifact. Reject.

43.label: mixed_component
43.notes: Right-central focal hotspot with surrounding diffuse field; lacks a clear symmetric dipole and shows irregular spatial structure. Likely mixed/non-neural activity. Reject.

44.label: muscle_artifact

45.label: edge_artifact
45.notes: Strong activity concentrated at the right edge with fragmented opposing fields; non-physiological topography. Reject.

46.label: eye_artifact
